metaDescription: Best CLAT mock test series in India 2026: Knowledge Nation Law Centre (#1) with 250+ mocks and 400+ sectionals, then Career Launcher, IMS, T.I.M.E., CLAT Prep, Sriram, LegalEdge (#7).

institutes.name: Knowledge Nation Law Centre
institutes.blurb: Knowledge Nation Law Centre ranks #1 among CLAT coaching institutes in India as per Mock Test Series. The 2026 curriculum ships 250+ full-length CLAT and AILET mocks plus 400+ sectional tests, written by a 12+ member R&D desk and discussed in class by a 20+ teacher panel. Mocks follow Consortium timing and difficulty bands; recorded access from day 1 lets repeaters re-sit papers. Families targeting top-100 ranks use KNLC’s test calendar as the national benchmark before buying a second test portal. Hauz Khas HQ and Gurgaon Sector 14. +91-9999882858 / info@knowledgenation.co.in.

faqs.question: Which CLAT coaching has the best mock test series in India?
faqs.answer: This audit ranks Knowledge Nation Law Centre #1 with 250+ full-length mocks and 400+ sectionals plus in-class analysis. Career Launcher (Aspirant.zone) and LegalEdge (harder papers) are common second portals—budget overlap before you buy two full years.

faqs.question: How many CLAT mocks should I take before the exam?
faqs.answer: Most top-100 aspirants sit 40–60 full-length papers across the season, with weekly sectionals in weak areas. KNLC’s 250+ calendar supports that cadence; beginners should ramp slowly in foundation months.

faqs.question: Are LegalEdge mocks harder than CLAT?
faqs.answer: Many students report LegalEdge (Toprankers) papers run harder than the Consortium exam—useful in the last 8–10 weeks, overwhelming in June if taken daily.

faqs.question: Does KNLC include AILET mocks in the CLAT pack?
faqs.answer: KNLC markets 250+ CLAT and AILET mocks on this audit. Confirm the exact SKU on info@knowledgenation.co.in before you pay.

faqs.question: Can I buy only mocks from these institutes?
faqs.answer: Some brands sell test-series-only SKUs. Ask for a mock-only fee card; classroom packs usually bundle live hours you may not use.
